title: Gen Labs asset-lib catalog entry
description: One entry per asset. Each area writes an ARRAY of these to asset-lib/catalog.d/<area>.json; tools/build-catalog.mjs merges + validates into catalog.json. Paths are relative to asset-lib/.

id.description: globally unique, dotted namespace: <type-ish>.<area>.<name>, e.g. sfx.kenney.click-001, char.vy.still.shock

tags.description: free tags: mood (curious, happy, tense, calm, shock...), use-case (transition, ui-click, quiz, cta...), character (nhi, vy)... Tier tag: quality B MUST carry "tier=reserve" (A = core, no tier tag needed).

energy.description: STD-17 intensity level(s) the asset suits

path.description: relative to asset-lib/ for files in git, OR absolute path when stored = local-scratch. One of path/url is required.

url.description: remote location when the file is not stored here (stored = remote)

files.description: for sets (icon-set, sfx pack, font family): number of files under path (a directory)

format.description: wav, mp3, ogg, png, svg, json(lottie), mp4, woff2, tsx ...

stored.description: git = file ≤5 MB committed; local-scratch = big file kept in scratchpad/alib-large (note why); remote = only url

source.description: who/what made it: 'Gen Labs (code: path/to/script)', 'Kenney (kenney.nl)', 'Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)', 'OpenRouter google/veo-3.1-lite' ...

source_url.description: page where the original + its license can be checked (required for third-party assets)

license.description: WHITELIST: only commercial-OK licenses. No NC/ND, no 'personal use'. Model outputs: owned by us per provider terms (Veo-Output).

attribution.description: exact credit text when the license requires it (CC-BY*). Empty/omitted otherwise.

commercial_ok.description: must be true — anything else is rejected by add.mjs/build-catalog.mjs

redistribution.description: free = CC0/MIT/OFL style; no-standalone = may be used inside our videos but raw files must not be shipped/sold as an asset pack (e.g. Mixkit, unDraw)

quality.description: A = core: showcase-grade, the default result of find.mjs. B = reserve: usable fallback, MUST carry tag "tier=reserve". C = junk, rejected — do not catalog.

quality_note.description: how it was judged (looked at frames / spectrum / auditioned by a human / automated check only)

placeholder.description: true = works but should be redone with a better source

how_made.description: command / model / prompt — enough to reproduce

reuse.description: one line: how to drop this into a new clip
